title: X-Fly: Learning to Reach and Stop in Full-Chunk Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.21450v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) agents built on large vision-language models are expensive to query. Executing a complete predicted action chunk before replanning amortizes this cost, reducing model inference from 195 to 42 ms per executed waypoint for our policy. It also moves the states at which the policy is queried away from expert demonstrations, which supervise neither recovery from these states nor termination at the learner's own arrival. On OpenFly test-seen, no-stop failures account for 47.78% of full-chunk behavior cloning (BC) outcomes. We present X-Fly, a staged training framework for full-chunk aerial VLN. Recovery DAgger labels learner-visited decision states with smooth chunks that reconnect to future expert segments and with STOP at the first in-region state. translated_title: X-Fly：在全动作块空中视觉语言导航中学习到达与停止
translated_abstract: 基于大型视觉语言模型的空中视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体查询成本高昂。在重新规划前执行完整的预测动作块可以摊薄这一成本，将本策略每个已执行路径点的模型推理时间从195毫秒降低至42毫秒。但这也使策略被查询时的状态偏离了专家演示所覆盖的范围，而专家演示既不监督从这些状态的恢复，也不监督学习者自身到达时的终止行为。在OpenFly测试可见集上，“无法停止”失败占完整动作块行为克隆（BC）结果的47.78%。我们提出X-Fly，一个面向全动作块空中VLN的分阶段训练框架。恢复DAgger（Recovery DAgger）为学习者访问过的决策状态标注平滑的动作块（可重新衔接至未来的专家片段），并在第一个进入目标区域的状态标注STOP。随后，Flow-GRPO基于同任务的闭环结果，联合优化分块流控制器与伯努利STOP策略，并辅以结果可验证……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: X-Fly提出了一种分阶段训练框架，通过恢复DAgger标注恢复动作块与停止指令，再用Flow-GRPO基于闭环结果联合优化分块流控制器和伯努利STOP策略，从而解决全动作块空中视觉语言导航中偏离专家状态导致的恢复失败和无法停止问题，同时将每个路径点的推理成本从195毫秒降至42毫秒。
en_tdlr: X-Fly is a staged training framework that uses Recovery DAgger to label recovery chunks and STOP actions, then applies Flow-GRPO to jointly refine a chunked flow controller and a Bernoulli STOP policy, solving recovery and no-stop failures in full-chunk aerial VLN while reducing per-waypoint inference cost from 195 to 42 ms.
